hidden.reason: Rosen's chart draws the axisymmetric universe, exponents (0, 0, 1); the ring embedded is of the universe that starts at (-2/7, 3/7, 6/7).

flat: Its moments are flat planes, and what the spacetime does is carried by its ring of free particles, stacked up its axis of time.
height: Its view tube stacks the ring of free particles up its axis of time, a grid whose height is the time.
